label: PCS Combined
info:
PCS Combined Flow - All PCS CAN parsers in one flow

Includes:
- PCS Status (0x66B969x)
- PCS DC Meas (0x66B96Dx, 0x66B96Ex)
- PCS AC Meas (0x66B966x, 0x66B967x, 0x66B968x)
- PCS Power (0x66B96Ax, 0x66B96Bx, 0x66B96Cx)
- PCS Temps (0x66B96Fx)
- PCS Algo Params (0x66B973x, 0x66B974x)
- PCS Timeouts (0x66B97Ax)
- PCS Fault Grp1 (0x66B978x)
- PCS Fault Grp2 (0x66B979x)

func:
const frame = msg.payload || msg;
let canId = frame.canid & 0x1FFFFFFF;
const data = frame.data || [];

if ((canId & 0xFFFFFFF0) !== 0x66B9780) {
    return null;
}

function getBit(buf, bitIndex) {
    const byteIndex = Math.floor(bitIndex / 8);
    const bitOffset = bitIndex % 8;
    if (byteIndex >= buf.length) return false;
    return ((buf[byteIndex] >> bitOffset) & 0x01) === 1;
}

let state = {
    kind: "PcsFaultGrp1State",
    version: 1,
    timestampUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
    pcs_hwEpoFault: getBit(data, 0),
    pcs_hwIgbtOcpFault: getBit(data, 1),
    pcs_hwBusOvFault: getBit(data, 2),
    pcs_hwWaveLimitFault: getBit(data, 3),
    pcs_hwBalWaveLimitFault: getBit(data, 4),
    pcs_hw24vPwrFault: getBit(data, 5),
    pcs_hwFanFault: getBit(data, 6),
    pcs_hwConnFault: getBit(data, 7),
    pcs_hwExtDi3Fault: getBit(data, 8),
    pcs_hwIndOvertFault: getBit(data, 9),
    pcs_hwPwrModOvert: getBit(data, 10),
    pcs_hwBalOvert: getBit(data, 11),
    pcs_hw15vPwrFault: getBit(data, 12),
    pcs_hwFireAlarmFault: getBit(data, 13),
    pcs_hwExtDi1Fault: getBit(data, 14),
    pcs_hwExtDi2Fault: getBit(data, 15),
    pcs_gridAOvFault: getBit(data, 16),
    pcs_gridBOvFault: getBit(data, 17),
    pcs_gridCOvFault: getBit(data, 18),
    pcs_gridAUvFault: getBit(data, 19),
    pcs_gridBUvFault: getBit(data, 20),
    pcs_gridCUvFault: getBit(data, 21),
    pcs_gridOverfFault: getBit(data, 22),
    pcs_gridUnderfFault: getBit(data, 23),
    pcs_gridPhSeqFault: getBit(data, 24),
    pcs_gridAOcFault: getBit(data, 25),
    pcs_gridBOcFault: getBit(data, 26),
    pcs_gridCOcFault: getBit(data, 27),
    pcs_gridVUnbalFault: getBit(data, 28),
    pcs_gridIUnbalFault: getBit(data, 29),
    pcs_gridPhLossFault: getBit(data, 30),
    pcs_gridNOcFault: getBit(data, 31),
    pcs_busPreOvFault: getBit(data, 32),
    pcs_busPreUvFault: getBit(data, 33),
    pcs_busRunOvFault: getBit(data, 34),
    pcs_busRunUvFault: getBit(data, 35),
    pcs_busUnbalFault: getBit(data, 36),
    pcs_batUvFault: getBit(data, 37),
    pcs_batOvFault: getBit(data, 38),
    pcs_dcPreOcFault: getBit(data, 39),
    pcs_dcOcFault: getBit(data, 40),
    pcs_balSwOcFault: getBit(data, 41),
    pcs_batRevFault: getBit(data, 42),
    pcs_acPreToFault: getBit(data, 43),
    pcs_acPreAOcFault: getBit(data, 44),
    pcs_acPreBOcFault: getBit(data, 45),
    pcs_acPreCOcFault: getBit(data, 46),
    pcs_acLeakOcFault: getBit(data, 47),
    pcs_acDcCompFault: getBit(data, 48),
    pcs_acPwrMisFault: getBit(data, 49),
    pcs_sysRamFault: getBit(data, 50),
    pcs_sysEepromFault: getBit(data, 51),
    pcs_sysAdDriftFault: getBit(data, 52),
    pcs_sysBackComFault: getBit(data, 53),
    pcs_sysCanProtFault: getBit(data, 54),
    pcs_sysCpldComFault: getBit(data, 55),
    pcs_sysDatalogFault: getBit(data, 56),
    pcs_sysInsulFault: getBit(data, 57),
    pcs_sysFwMisFault: getBit(data, 58),
    pcs_sysBmsStatFault: getBit(data, 59),
    pcs_sysStsComFault: getBit(data, 60),
    pcs_sysBmsComFault: getBit(data, 61),
    pcs_sysParCanFault: getBit(data, 62),
    pcs_sysEmsComFault: getBit(data, 63)
};

const allFaultFlags = [
    'pcs_hwEpoFault', 'pcs_hwIgbtOcpFault', 'pcs_hwBusOvFault', 'pcs_hwWaveLimitFault',
    'pcs_hwBalWaveLimitFault', 'pcs_hw24vPwrFault', 'pcs_hwFanFault', 'pcs_hwConnFault',
    'pcs_hwExtDi3Fault', 'pcs_hwIndOvertFault', 'pcs_hwPwrModOvert', 'pcs_hwBalOvert',
    'pcs_hw15vPwrFault', 'pcs_hwFireAlarmFault', 'pcs_hwExtDi1Fault', 'pcs_hwExtDi2Fault',
    'pcs_gridAOvFault', 'pcs_gridBOvFault', 'pcs_gridCOvFault', 'pcs_gridAUvFault',
    'pcs_gridBUvFault', 'pcs_gridCUvFault', 'pcs_gridOverfFault', 'pcs_gridUnderfFault',
    'pcs_gridPhSeqFault', 'pcs_gridAOcFault', 'pcs_gridBOcFault', 'pcs_gridCOcFault',
    'pcs_gridVUnbalFault', 'pcs_gridIUnbalFault', 'pcs_gridPhLossFault', 'pcs_gridNOcFault',
    'pcs_busPreOvFault', 'pcs_busPreUvFault', 'pcs_busRunOvFault', 'pcs_busRunUvFault',
    'pcs_busUnbalFault', 'pcs_batUvFault', 'pcs_batOvFault', 'pcs_dcPreOcFault',
    'pcs_dcOcFault', 'pcs_balSwOcFault', 'pcs_batRevFault', 'pcs_acPreToFault',
    'pcs_acPreAOcFault', 'pcs_acPreBOcFault', 'pcs_acPreCOcFault', 'pcs_acLeakOcFault',
    'pcs_acDcCompFault', 'pcs_acPwrMisFault', 'pcs_sysRamFault', 'pcs_sysEepromFault',
    'pcs_sysAdDriftFault', 'pcs_sysBackComFault', 'pcs_sysCanProtFault', 'pcs_sysCpldComFault',
    'pcs_sysDatalogFault', 'pcs_sysInsulFault', 'pcs_sysFwMisFault', 'pcs_sysBmsStatFault',
    'pcs_sysStsComFault', 'pcs_sysBmsComFault', 'pcs_sysParCanFault', 'pcs_sysEmsComFault'
];

let activeFaults = [];
allFaultFlags.forEach(flag => {
    if (state[flag] === true) activeFaults.push(flag);
});

state.pcs_hasFaultGrp1 = activeFaults.length > 0;
state.pcs_activeFaultsGrp1 = activeFaults;
state.pcs_activeFaultCountGrp1 = activeFaults.length;

flow.set("pcsFaultGrp1State", state);
msg.payload = state;
return msg;
